title: Fix buttons.ts eventBitMap: release/press/rollOver bit values are all wrong
description: The eventBitMap in packages/swf/src/buttons.ts has systematically wrong bit values. release=0x0001 (should be 0x0008), press=0x0002 (should be 0x0004), rollOver=0x0040 (should be 0x0001), rollOut=0x0020 (should be 0x0002), dragOut=0x0004 (should be 0x0010), dragOver=0x0008 (should be 0x0020), releaseOutside=0x0010 (should be 0x0040). Ruffle authoritative source: ruffle/swf/src/types.rs ButtonActionCondition. All affected unit tests asserting specific condBits values must be updated. E2e button-roundtrip.spec.ts comment needs update (test still passes but now fires for the correct reason).
